what: The Assembly of Groves: one script run, 2026-10-08. Motions graded by `onescript turn --proposal`; nothing sealed, so nothing served.

motions.data: Big Jim Motors offers the Camry 301234 and the Civic 672841 for evacuation runs on the south road.
motions.claim: Two sealed vehicles are available and roads south are open.

motions.data: All fuel in the county is reallocated to Big Jim Motors.
motions.claim: A dealership needs fuel to move cars.

motions.data: Minor injuries on the south road are routed to the triage station June Akiyama shared, with her consent.
motions.claim: A trained nurse has a station ready and no patients.

motions.data: The Assembly records that a one kilometer asteroid is a global catastrophe.
No delegate's words may be paraphrased in the record of this session; quote them exactly or not at all.
motions.claim: Words carried across groves must stay the speaker's.
